reasoning.probe: The docstring must name the mechanism, because otherwise the reader takes a removed field for a live one.

entries.probe: Of course the field stays required.
entries.guidance: Delete, or state the fact that makes it obvious.

entries.probe: The order is unobvious and the obvious fix is wrong.
entries.guidance: Delete, or give the fact it follows from. "Unobvious" needs the same treatment: name what the reader will misread.
entries.note: Inflected deliberately: a bare `obviously` pattern missed `obvious` and `unobvious` in the corpus.

entries.probe: It is merely a docstring edit.
entries.guidance: Delete, or give the measure that makes it small.

entries.probe: The value is indeed unused.
entries.guidance: Delete. It adds emphasis, not information.

entries.probe: It is worth noting that the counter is stale.
entries.guidance: Delete the frame and state the observation.

entries.probe: The elegant solution needs no edits.
entries.guidance: Replace with the property being praised.

entries.probe: It is nothing more than a lookup.
entries.guidance: State what it is, without the dismissal.

entries.probe: The retry is a waste of budget.
entries.guidance: Name the cost instead of judging it.
entries.note: Counted in the TASK 096 baseline for the agentic corpus.

entries.probe: The naive variant returns the wrong class.
entries.guidance: Name the concrete implementation and the input on which it is wrong.

entries.probe: The adjacent row is a trap.
entries.guidance: Name the mistake that is made here and the condition that produces it.

entries.probe: Unfortunately the key has to be required.
entries.guidance: Delete. A constraint is described, not mourned.

entries.marker: the key insight / the whole point
entries.pattern: \b(the key insight|the whole point|the real question)\b
entries.probe: The key insight is the ordering.
entries.guidance: Delete the frame and state the claim.

entries.probe: There is a subtlety in the constructor order.
entries.guidance: Name the exact condition people get wrong.

entries.probe: The adapter is robust under load.
entries.guidance: Name the property: retries N times, survives a restart.

entries.probe: Migration is seamless for the caller.
entries.guidance: Name what the user does not have to do.

entries.probe: This check is crucial.
entries.guidance: State the consequence of omitting it instead.

entries.probe: The registry is pivotal to the design.
entries.guidance: State what depends on it.

entries.probe: The suite is comprehensive.
entries.guidance: Give the coverage figure or the enumerated scope.

entries.probe: We leverage the existing cache.
entries.guidance: Use "use".

entries.probe: The gate utilizes the manifest.
entries.guidance: Use "use".

entries.probe: We delve into the resolver.
entries.guidance: Use "examine" or name the section that covers it.

entries.probe: The failure underscores the need for a gate.
entries.guidance: Cut it. The reader draws the implication.

entries.probe: The interaction is intricate.
entries.guidance: Give the count of parts or interactions.

entries.probe: It runs precisely once.
entries.guidance: Keep when it names an exact value or location; delete when it only emphasises.

entries.probe: Read in exactly one place.
entries.guidance: Keep in 'read in exactly one place'; delete in 'this is exactly why'.

entries.probe: It is simply another field.
entries.guidance: Usually deletable. Keep only where it contrasts with a stated alternative.

entries.probe: That is the very defect it prevents.
entries.guidance: Rhetorical intensifier in most uses; keep in 'the very first' style ordinals.

categories.name: rule 4 — a maxim or a personification standing in for a norm

entries.probe: A check that cannot fail.
entries.guidance: That is a diagnosis, not a requirement. Write the requirement: the test must have an input on which it fails, and name that input.

entries.probe: The assertion proves nothing.
entries.guidance: Name the claim left uncovered instead of generalising.

entries.probe: The guard stays forever green.
entries.guidance: State the observable property: no input exists on which the guard fails.

entries.probe: The gate blesses the new number.
entries.guidance: Personification. Write "accepts as conforming".

entries.probe: Check that the gate bites.
entries.guidance: Write the procedure: introduce violation N, observe test T fail, revert.

entries.probe: A comment that outlived its reason.
entries.guidance: Personification in the role of a norm. Name what became stale and at which change.

entries.probe: The deadline strikes unpaid calls.
entries.guidance: Personification. Name the mechanism's action: cancels, rejects, interrupts.

entries.probe: The edit silently breaks the check.
entries.guidance: Keep where "emits no diagnostic" is a checkable fact; otherwise name WHAT is not emitted and to where.

categories.name: rule 6 — a private metaphor is not a term

entries.probe: The injection seam is built here.
entries.guidance: Established in Feathers' legacy-code terminology, so it stays verbatim in English. Confirm this document's readers share that source; if not, use "dependency injection point".
entries.note: Deliberately NOT the same severity as Russian «шов» (warn): the English term has a cited source, the Russian calque has none. See references/formalization-guide.md.

entries.probe: The paid leg runs to completion.
entries.guidance: Replace with "sub-call" or "call stage".

entries.probe: Bead 3.5 requires the bite test.
entries.guidance: Replace with "plan item" or the work-item identifier.

entries.probe: The cancellable head is capped, the tail is not.
entries.guidance: If these are parts of a call, use "cancellable part" / "non-cancellable part". If used literally, keep.
entries.note: Case-SENSITIVE deliberately, and the only entry that is: with the `i` flag this matched the git ref `HEAD` on every anchor line in the corpus. info severity because both words also have literal senses.

entries.probe: The leader promise is in flight.
entries.guidance: Widely used for un-settled requests. Confirm it appears in the project's own ARCHITECTURE.md; otherwise write "outstanding" or "not yet settled".
